$comment: The Twilio number inventory — the source of truth for what each number is
for and whether it may be released. This file exists because the numbers
used to live as inline defaults across four files with only one of them
documented, which is how a release step aimed at 'the WhatsApp numbers'
can reach for the sign-in number instead.
owner tells you WHO configures the number's webhooks. Never point a
Twilio-side webhook at a number owned by elevenlabs — its voice URL is
ElevenLabs' and overwriting it silently kills the Reservationist.
releasable=false means releasing it breaks something live. Releasing is
irreversible: Twilio does not give a number back.

numbers.name: Mesita Reservations (Businesses)
numbers.purpose: Venue-facing reservation line. a1 dials venues from it; a4 answers venues on it. Imported into ElevenLabs; its Twilio voice + messaging webhooks belong to ElevenLabs. Code default: ELEVENLABS_FROM_NUMBER in _shared/elevenlabs.ts.

numbers.name: Mesita Reservations (Consumers)
numbers.purpose: Guest-facing reservation line. a2 dials guests from it; a3 answers guests on it. An ElevenLabs number binds to ONE inbound agent, so a3 and a4 cannot share a line. Once bought: import into ElevenLabs, bind inbound to a3, set the EF secret ELEVENLABS_CONSUMER_FROM_NUMBER. Until then the code falls back to the business line.

numbers.name: Mesita Verifications (Consumers)
numbers.purpose: Phone-OTP sign-in — the ONLY consumer auth path there is. Attached to a Twilio Messaging Service; Supabase Auth sends through it directly via config.toml [auth.sms.twilio] (TWILIO_MESSAGE_SERVICE_SID). No Edge Function touches it. If this number goes dark, nobody can sign in.

numbers.name: Canzeco Virtual Phone
numbers.purpose: Not Mesita — the company's general US line. Do NOT release without checking whether it is the number on file with Stripe Atlas, Mercury, or the registered agent; releasing it could lock you out of bank 2FA.

numbers.name: Mesita Notifications (Consumers)
numbers.purpose: RETIRED — was the consumer WhatsApp sender. Nothing sends WhatsApp: there is no call to Twilio's Messages.json anywhere in the codebase. Safe to release.

numbers.name: Mesita Ops (Businesses)
numbers.purpose: RETIRED — was the staff WhatsApp sender, dead since the waiter identity was retired (MESITA-833). Safe to release.
